name: Yuxisaurus
isnote: Recovered as the sister of Emausaurus or of Scelidosaurus plus Eurypoda (Yao et al. 2022); placed in Thyreophora.
sum: Yuxisaurus is an early armoured dinosaur from the Early Jurassic of Yunnan, China, proof that thyreophorans lived in Asia then.
holotype: CVEB 21701, a partial skeleton with parts of the skull, vertebrae, limb bones and at least 120 osteoderms — Fengjiahe Formation, Yunnan.
biology: Known from armour and partial bones; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Yao et al. 2022
